title: Dust-and-Disruption Days by Room
dataSources: Renovation tasks (`reno:task`), budget and receipts (`reno:budget`), material orders (`reno:material`), inspections (`reno:inspection`), contractor logs (`reno:contractor`).
app: Home-renovation project management — task boards (Trello, Notion), budget and receipt trackers, material orders, and inspection / permit logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:contractor disruption_level=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(disruption_level) as avg_disruption, count as work_days by _time room
| sort 0 _time room
description: Tracks which rooms are absorbing the most dust, noise, or access disruption across the project.
value: Renovation pain is not just cost and schedule; disruption heat helps households plan around the messy phases.
implementation: Capture daily disruption level in contractor logs and trend it by room.
visualization: Heatmap of daily disruption level by room.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which rooms are taking the biggest hit from dust, noise, and disruption during the work.
